title: Make / made / made
about: Everyday phrases with make: making drinks, meals, photocopies and videos, saying how things make you feel, and expressions like make a mistake, make a noise and make your bed. It also shows where English uses make, not do.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Українське «робити» англійською буває і make, і do. Make — коли ти щось створюєш і з'являється результат: кава, вечеря, відео, шум, безлад, помилка (make tea, make a noise, make a mess, make a mistake). Do — коли виконуєш роботу чи завдання: do your homework, do the washing. А «сфотографувати» — взагалі take a photo. Такі вирази запам'ятовуй цілими.

items.pattern: make (some) coffee · make a coffee · make sb a coffee
items.example: Mum **makes coffee** for everyone every morning.
more: Shall I **make you a coffee**?
Who **made the coffee** this morning? It's really good.
items.watchOut: «Зварити каву» — make coffee, а не cook coffee чи boil coffee. Have a coffee — випити каву, а не приготувати її.

items.pattern: make (some) tea · make a cup / a pot of tea · make sb a cup of tea
items.example: When we arrived, Aunt Maria **made tea** for everyone.
more: Can you **make me a cup of tea**, please?
We **made tea** on a little fire in the forest.
items.watchOut: «Заварити чай» — make tea, не cook tea і не boil tea. Boil — кип'ятити: boil the water.

items.pattern: make (some) hot chocolate · make sb a hot chocolate
items.meaning: get a hot drink of chocolate and milk ready
items.example: On cold evenings I **make hot chocolate** for my little brother.
more: My friend **makes** the best **hot chocolate** in town.
Dad **made us hot chocolate** with lots of milk.

items.pattern: make breakfast / lunch / dinner (no a or the) · make dinner for sb
items.example: My sister **makes breakfast** for us on Sundays.
more: Who's going to **make dinner** tonight?
Dad **made lunch** for us before he went to work.
items.watchOut: Без артикля: make dinner, а не make a dinner. Можна сказати й cook dinner. А have dinner — це вечеряти, тобто їсти, а не готувати.

items.pattern: make a photocopy (of sth) · make a copy
items.meaning: copy a page on a machine
items.example: Can you **make a photocopy** of my passport, please?
more: The teacher **made thirty photocopies** of the test.
I **made a copy** of the map for each of us.
items.watchOut: Ксерокопія — a photocopy або просто a copy, апарат — a photocopier. Слово xerox у британській англійській майже не вживають.

items.pattern: make a film / a video (about sth)
items.meaning: record a story or an event with a camera
items.example: Our class is **making a video** about our town.
more: Teenagers love **making videos** with their phones.
We **made a short film** about our holiday.
items.watchOut: «Зняти фільм» — make a film. А сфотографувати — take a photo, а не make a photo! Film — британське слово, movie — американське.

items.pattern: sth makes me (feel) tired · it made us (feel) tired
items.meaning: you feel tired because of it
items.example: Hot weather always **makes me feel tired**.
more: Swimming **makes me tired**, but I sleep really well after it.
The long journey **made us all feel tired**.
items.watchOut: Після make + людина — дієслово без to: it makes me feel tired, не makes me to feel. Feel можна пропустити: it makes me tired.

items.pattern: sth / sb makes me (feel) angry · it made her angry
items.meaning: you feel angry because of it
items.example: It **makes me angry** when people drop rubbish in the park.
more: When my team loses, it **makes me** really **angry**.
Please stop shouting. It **makes your sister angry**.
items.watchOut: «Мене це злить» — It makes me angry. Англійською на першому місці те, що злить (it), а людина стоїть після makes.

items.pattern: sth makes me (feel) sad · opposite: makes me (feel) happy
items.meaning: you feel sad because of it
items.example: Saying goodbye to my friends at the station **made me sad**.
more: Rainy days **make me feel** a bit **sad**.
That song always **makes my mum happy**.
items.watchOut: Після make me — прикметник: it makes me sad, а не sadly. Протилежне — it makes me happy (мене це тішить).

items.pattern: make a mistake · make mistakes (in sth)
items.meaning: do something wrong when you don't want to
items.example: Sorry, I **made a mistake**. Your name is Olena, not Alina.
more: Don't be afraid to **make mistakes**.
Dad **made a mistake** and bought the wrong milk.
items.watchOut: «Зробити помилку» — make a mistake, не do a mistake.

items.pattern: make an appointment (with the doctor / dentist) (for Friday)
items.meaning: choose a time to see a doctor, a dentist, etc.
items.example: My tooth hurts, so I've **made an appointment** with the dentist for Friday.
more: Can I **make an appointment** for Monday morning?
You can **make an appointment** online or by phone.
items.watchOut: «Записатися до лікаря» — make an appointment, не write to the doctor і не do an appointment. Have an appointment — уже бути записаним: I have an appointment at five.

items.meaning: make your bed tidy after you get up
items.example: Mum says I can't play until I **make my bed**.
more: Do you **make your bed** every morning?
We **made the beds** for our guests.
items.watchOut: «Застелити ліжко» — make the bed, а не lay the bed чи clean the bed. Lay — про стіл: lay the table — накрити на стіл.

items.pattern: make a noise · make a lot of noise · make a funny noise
items.meaning: make a sound, often a loud one
items.example: Shh! Don't **make a noise**. Grandpa is sleeping.
more: Our neighbours' dog **makes a lot of noise** at night.
Try not to **make a noise** when you come home late.
items.watchOut: Шуміти — make a noise, не do a noise. A noise — один звук; a lot of noise — багато шуму (без a).

items.pattern: make a mess (in a room / on the floor) · make a terrible mess
items.meaning: make a place dirty or untidy
items.example: The dog came in from the rain and **made a mess** on the carpet.
more: Please don't **make a mess** in the bathroom.
We **made a terrible mess** when we painted my room.
items.watchOut: «Наробити безладу» — make a mess, не do a mess. Не забувай a: make a mess.

items.pattern: make a (good / bad) choice · make the right choice
items.meaning: choose one thing from two or more
items.example: It's difficult to **make a choice** when everything looks so good.
more: You **made the right choice**. The green bike is perfect for you.
Take your time. You don't have to **make a choice** now.
items.watchOut: «Зробити вибір» — make a choice, не do a choice. Простіше — choose: I chose the red one.

items.pattern: make friends (with sb) · make new friends
items.meaning: meet people and become their friend
items.example: On my first day at the new school I **made friends** with a girl called Sofia.
more: My cousin is shy, but he **makes friends** quickly.
Joining a club is a good way to **make new friends**.
items.watchOut: «Подружитися з кимось» — make friends with sb. Friends завжди у множині, навіть про одну людину: I made friends with Anna.

items.example: Mum is **making a phone call**. Please be quiet for a minute.
more: Mum **made a phone call** to the school because I was ill.
I **made a quick call** to my friend to say I was late.
items.watchOut: «Зробити дзвінок» — make a call, не do a call. Можна й просто call або phone: I called my grandma.

warmup.uk: Я зробив помилку в останньому слові.
warmup.q: I ___ a mistake in the last word.
warmup.explain: Помилку «роблять» з make: make a mistake. Do a mistake — калька з української.

warmup.uk: Не шуміть, будь ласка, — я роблю уроки.
warmup.q: Please don't ___ a noise. I'm doing my homework.
warmup.explain: Шуміти — make a noise. А уроки — do: do my homework. Українське «робити» англійською буває і make, і do.
Застелити ліжко — make the bed. Lay — тільки про стіл: lay the table.

warmup.q: I need to ___ an appointment at the hairdresser's.
warmup.explain: Записатися на прийом — make an appointment. Write — калька з «записатися».
Після make + людина — дієслово без to і без -ing: makes me feel tired.
Зварити каву — make coffee. Cook і boil з кавою не вживають.

warmup.q: Just a minute, I have to ___ a phone call.
warmup.explain: Зателефонувати — make a phone call або просто call sb. Give a phone call без «кому» не кажуть (тільки give sb a call), а call a phone call — зайве повторення.

warmup.uk: На канікулах я подружився з хлопцем з Польщі.
warmup.q: On holiday I ___ friends with a boy from Poland.
warmup.explain: Подружитися з кимось — make friends with sb. Friends — завжди у множині.

A.q: He's at the machine, making a ___ of the letter for me.
A.explain: Ксерокопія — a photocopy. Make a photo — помилка: фотографують take a photo.

A.q: Shall I ___ you a hot chocolate before bed?
A.explain: Напої готують з make: make hot chocolate, make tea, make coffee. Cook і boil тут не підходять.

A.q: Dad is ___ dinner for us. It smells great!
A.explain: Make dinner — приготувати вечерю (можна й cook dinner). Have dinner — вечеряти, тобто їсти.

B.q: Losing the match ___ us feel really sad.
B.explain: Make + людина + feel + прикметник: it made us feel sad. Do і get у цій конструкції не вживають.

B.q: Someone broke my bike and didn't say sorry. It made me so ___!
B.explain: Made me angry — мене це розізлило. Hungry — голодний, cold — холодний.

B.q: Too much homework makes me ___ tired.
B.explain: Після make me — дієслово без to і без -ing: makes me feel tired. Або просто makes me tired.

C.q: Oops! I've ___ a mistake in your phone number.
C.explain: Помилку роблять з make: make a mistake. Do a mistake — калька з української.

C.q: You can use my paints, but don't ___ a mess on the table.
C.explain: Наробити безладу — make a mess, не do a mess.

C.q: We ___ a bad choice. The film was really boring.
C.explain: Зробити вибір — make a choice. Do і take із choice не вживають.

example.title: What a Saturday!
example.uk:
У суботу зранку я застелила ліжко, а потім приготувала сніданок для своїх молодших братів. Їм дуже сподобалося, але вони влаштували на кухні жахливий безлад.

Після сніданку мама зварила каву й зателефонувала стоматологові. Вона записалася на прийом на понеділок.

Після обіду хлопці грали у футбол у дворі й страшенно галасували. Мене це розізлило, тож я пішла в парк. Там я подружилася з дівчинкою з моєї нової школи. Оце так день!
example.en:
On Saturday morning I [[made my bed|c3]] and then [[made breakfast|a4]] for my little brothers. They loved it, but they [[made a terrible mess|c5]] in the kitchen.

After breakfast Mum [[made some coffee|a1]] and [[made a phone call|c8]] to the dentist. She [[made an appointment|c2]] for Monday.

In the afternoon the boys played football in the garden and [[made a lot of noise|c4]]. It [[made me angry|b2]], so I went to the park. There I [[made friends|c7]] with a girl from my new school. What a day!
